name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

meta.wiki: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

summary: Hansel Heavyhands cannot fight with his feet in such disarray. So he sends you to slay twenty incendosaurs in the Slag Pit, where Scrange and Burninate want the lava pools cleared for expeditionary teams.

sections.title: Bunions upon Bunions
sections.body: Hansel Heavyhands cannot fight while his bunions are in such a state. Scrange and Burninate told him to kill the incendosaurs so expeditionary teams can explore the Slag Pit’s lava pools. Now he sends you in his place.

sections.title: The Lava Pools
sections.body: The incendosaurs occupy the lava pools in the Slag Pit, within the Cauldron. Hansel wants twenty slain before you return.

faq.answer: Hansel Heavyhands gives you work in the Searing Gorge. Scrange and Burninate told him to deal with the incendosaurs, but his bunions keep him from fighting.

faq.q: Why do the incendosaurs need to be cleared out?
faq.answer: Scrange and Burninate want expeditionary teams to explore the Slag Pit’s lava pools. The incendosaurs there are said to be causing all kinds of problems.
The incendosaurs live in the lava pools of the Slag Pit, within the Cauldron.

faq.q: Why won't Hansel hunt them himself?
faq.answer: Hansel says his bunions have bunions. His feet are in too much disarray for him to kill anything.
